async def act(page):
    import asyncio
    # Change the 'Show By:' combobox to 'Month' to view data by month
    show_by_combobox = page.get_by_role("main").get_by_role("combobox", name="Show By:", exact=True)
    await show_by_combobox.select_option("Month")
    # Wait for the page to update after changing the selection
